exposure: INCHON index (combining FRI with umbilical cord blood and 4-minute umbilical artery blood parameters)
Umbilical cord and umbilical artery blood parameters (base excess, pH, PO2)
Continuous neonatal heart rate (rate, variability, reactivity)
outcome: Transition from fetal to postnatal physiology
cohort: The cohort consisted of neonates born from closely monitored labors and deliveries, drawn from a 45-year-old research database.
finding: The developed metrics, FRI and INCHON, clearly discriminated and predicted low, medium, and high-risk neonatal physiology, improving the identification of decreased fetal reserve and babies at risk for neurologic injury.
followup_time: 64 minutes after birth (continuous neonatal surveillance for an additional hour)
